name: Latent diffusion model for storm behavior prediction

mentions.name: Latent diffusion model for storm behavior prediction
mentions.description: This project trains a latent diffusion model on weather radar data to predict short-term storm behavior. It has shown decent results on downscaled data at a +30 minute horizon, with full-resolution models in training for +1h and +2h horizons.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm training a latent diffusion model on weather radar data to predict short-term storm behavior. Decent results so far on downscaled data at +30min, training a full-res model at +1h and +2h horizons now.
